description_sq:
Shitet Apartament 1+1 ne Kashar prane Casa Italias me siperfaqe ndertimi 85.6m2 me dokumentacion te rregullt nga firma, ne katin e 6 te nje pallati te ri me ashensor.
Prona ka nje organizim teper funksional: 
1 dhome gjumi
kuzhine+sallon (kuzhina e vecuar)
koridor shperndares te te gjitha dhomave
 tualet
2 ballkone me dalje nga dhoma e ndenjes dhe kuzhina 
Specifikat e prones
Apartamenti do te jepet i investuar nga firma me: 
parket
sistem kapot
termoizolim
hidrosanitare incaso
dritare plastik me xhama triplo
Apartamenti shitet bosh.
Viti i ndertimit te pallatit: 2026
description_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in Kashar near Casa Italia with a construction area of ​​85.6m2 with regular documentation from the company, on the 6th floor of a new building with an elevator. The property has a very functional organization: 1 bedroom, kitchen + living room (separate kitchen), distribution corridor of all rooms, toilet, 2 balconies with exit from the living room and kitchen. Property specifications. The apartment will be provided invested by the company with: parquet system, thermal insulation, hydrosanitary incaso, plastic windows with triple glazing. The apartment is sold empty. Year of construction of the building: 2026
